summary: Iteration 9 verified the profile goal-badge overflow fix + 'See more' translucent modal in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx. ALL 4 review-request items PASS on the public preview URL. (1) TRUNCATION: seeded @hera_user (localStorage, double-JSON per web AsyncStorage shim) with a 233-char goal + 2 short goals; profile card badges render inside the card - measured geometry: card x 24-366 (342px wide), badges at [64-196],[204-326] row1 and [136-254] row2, zero left/right overflow, each <=48% card width, 2-per-row wrap confirmed. Exactly one 'See more' hint (only the >42-char goal). (2) MODAL: tapping the long badge opens the modal with the COMPLETE goal text fully wrapped (132px tall, ~6 lines, lineHeight 22px), no horizontal scroll; dark theme container verified rgba(18,20,42,0.82); Close button dismisses; backdrop tap (click at 8,8) also dismisses; reopen works. (3) REGRESSION: avatar (M initial), name 'Maya', '7-day streak', 'Upload Photo' all render; zero page errors, zero console errors across 3 runs. (4) LIGHT THEME: toggled appearance switch (role=switch nth(0)) - modal container verified rgba(255,255,255,0.88) with dark text rgb(26,10,20) (readable), wrapped, no h-scroll; toggled back to dark. BONUS BUG FOUND+FIXED: Cloud Sync row showed 'Sync failed - tap to retry' for a valid premium session. RCA: emergent-client queryBuilder .single() resolves ok(null) (never PGRST116), and syncService.pullUserData unconditionally dereferenced data.name -> TypeError -> pullU.error -> syncStatus 'error'. One-line defensive fix added in syncService.ts (if (!data) return {data:{},error:null}) mirroring the existing PGRST116 intent; applyRemoteData guards empty userData so no local data wipe. Re-verified after expo restart: sync label now 'Just now' (success), goals preserved, badges/modal intact.

rca_of_issue: REVIEWED BUG (fixed by E1, verified): goalsRow shrink-wrapped under profileCard alignItems:'center' so goalBadge maxWidth:'48%' never resolved -> long goals overflowed the card; fix adds alignSelf:'stretch' + row layout + Pressable + 'See more' (>42 chars) + translucent Modal with wrapped full text. NEW BUG FOUND BY TESTER (fixed): Cloud Sync row permanently showed 'Sync failed - tap to retry' for authenticated users. RCA: template/core/emergent-client.ts queryBuilder stub returns ok(null) for .single() (never a PGRST116 error); services/syncService.ts pullUserData then dereferenced data.name on null -> TypeError -> caught -> pullU.error -> HeraContext syncNow sets syncStatus='error' (HeraContext.tsx:338). Reproduction: log in, open Settings, observe Cloud Sync row. Mitigation applied: `if (!data) return { data: {}, error: null }` after the error check in pullUserData (syncService.ts:~291), consistent with the existing PGRST116 branch; applyRemoteData ignores empty userData so no local state is overwritten. Verified post-fix: sync label 'Just now', goals/badges/modal unaffected.
